FLIP.title: Flip
FLIP.text: Flip a coin. It lands on Heads or Tails, and each face has its own effect. When one face is bad, Heads is the good one.

RETAIN.title: Retain
RETAIN.text: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of turn.

SQUANDER.title: Squander
SQUANDER.text: Spend X [gold]Gold[/gold] to gain X [gold]Chips[/gold]. A card with a [gold]Squander[/gold] cost can't be played without the [gold]Gold[/gold]. If an effect makes you [gold]Squander[/gold] more than you have, gain 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] instead.

ROLL.title: Roll
ROLL.text: Roll the dice shown (each D6 lands on 1 to 6) and use the result: as damage, [gold]Block[/gold] or Gold, or to pick which effect happens. 1 is bad, 6 is good. [gold]Black Bow Meow[/gold] raises your [gold]Rolls[/gold].

CHIPS.title: Chips
CHIPS.text: Ecaflip's second resource, gained from Gold Bond each turn and by [gold]Squandering[/gold] [gold]Gold[/gold], and spent like Energy. Unspent [gold]Chips[/gold] turn back into [gold]Gold[/gold] at the end of combat.

ALL_OR_NOTHING.title: All or Nothing
ALL_OR_NOTHING.text: Your [gold]Rolls[/gold] become [gold]Flips[/gold]: Heads lands on the highest face, Tails on the lowest.

ENERGY.title: Energy
ENERGY.text: Energy is used to play cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold].

EXHAUST.title: Exhaust
EXHAUST.text: Removed until the end of combat.

SHRINK.title: Shrink
SHRINK.text: This creature's Attacks deal [blue]30%[/blue] less damage for the next 3 turns.

BLACK_BOW_MEOW.title: Black Bow Meow
BLACK_BOW_MEOW.text:
Your [gold]Rolls[/gold] from cards are raised by up to [blue]0[/blue]. Each die tops out at 6, and only the points used are spent.
At the end of your turn, gain [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].

VIGOR.title: Vigor
VIGOR.text: Your next Attack deals additional damage.

KITTIKAZE_SWARM.title: Kittikaze Swarm
KITTIKAZE_SWARM.text: Whenever you [gold]Roll[/gold] or [gold]Flip[/gold], deal [blue]0[/blue] damage to a random enemy.

ETHEREAL.title: Ethereal
ETHEREAL.text: If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of this turn, it is [gold]Exhausted[/gold].

BOW_MEOW_FAMILIAR.title: Bow Meow Familiar
BOW_MEOW_FAMILIAR.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Black Bow Meow[/gold]. Whenever [gold]Black Bow Meow[/gold] is used, draw 1 card.

BOX_CARS_PAYOUT.title: Box Cars Payout
BOX_CARS_PAYOUT.text:
1: [gold]Squander[/gold] 1 Gold
2: Gain 1 [gold]Vigor[/gold]
3: Gain 1 [gold]Weak[/gold]
4: Gain 1 [gold]Block[/gold]
5: Gain 1 Gold
6: Lock the die

WEAK.title: Weak
WEAK.text: Weakened creatures deal [blue]25%[/blue] less damage with Attacks.

CHESHIRE_GRIN.title: Cheshire Grin
CHESHIRE_GRIN.text: Whenever you [gold]Flip[/gold] Heads, deal [blue]0[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.

STRENGTH.title: Strength
STRENGTH.text: Strength adds additional damage to Attacks.

DEPOSIT.title: Deposit
DEPOSIT.text: Holds [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Chips[/gold], paid out as [gold]Gold[/gold] at the end of combat. Grows at the start of each turn if you took no unblocked damage since your last turn (max 50).

DOUBLE_DOWN.title: Double Down
DOUBLE_DOWN.text: The next card you play this turn that [gold]Rolls[/gold] or [gold]Flips[/gold] is played twice.

FELINE_GRACE.title: Feline Grace
FELINE_GRACE.text: The first time each turn you [gold]Flip[/gold] Tails, gain [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].

INNATE.title: Innate
INNATE.text: Start each combat with this card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].

FELINE_LEAP.title: Feline Leap
FELINE_LEAP.text: The next Attack you play [gold]Rolls[/gold] the highest face on every die.

VULNERABLE.title: Vulnerable
VULNERABLE.text: Vulnerable creatures take [blue]50%[/blue] more damage from Attacks.

HIGH_ROLLER.title: High Roller
HIGH_ROLLER.text: Your [gold]Bonus[/gold] counts double. At the start of your turn, gain [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] [gold]Bonus[/gold] times.

HOUSE_ALWAYS_WINS.title: House Always Wins
HOUSE_ALWAYS_WINS.text: Whenever you spend [gold]Chips[/gold], deal that much damage to a random enemy, [blue]0[/blue] times.

INSURANCE.title: Insurance
INSURANCE.text: At the start of your next turn, gain [gold]Gold[/gold] equal to the unblocked damage you took until then.

INVESTMENT.title: Investment
INVESTMENT.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Ends the first time you take unblocked damage.

LOADED_DIE.title: Loaded Die
LOADED_DIE.text: The first [blue]0[/blue] cards you play each turn that [gold]Rolls[/gold] cost 1 less [img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/colorless_energy_icon.png[/img].

LUCKY_STREAK.title: Lucky Streak
LUCKY_STREAK.text: The first time each turn a card [gold]Rolls[/gold] a 6, gain [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].

PURR.title: Purr
PURR.text: Whenever you spend [gold]Chips[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the amount spent (min 1), [blue]0[/blue] times.

SAVAGE_BOW_MEOW.title: Savage Bow Meow
SAVAGE_BOW_MEOW.text: The first time you would die, prevent it, then [gold]Roll[/gold] 6D6: Heal that much.

DEBILITATE.title: Debilitate
DEBILITATE.text: [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective for the next [blue]2[/blue] turns.

TAILS_NEVER_FAILS.title: Tails Never Fails
TAILS_NEVER_FAILS.text: Your next [blue]0[/blue] Tails count as Heads.

WHISKER_SENSE.title: Whisker Sense
WHISKER_SENSE.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Black Bow Meow[/gold].
